description: Response of GET /app-versions/{id}/google-play-store/staged-rollout-schedule (Release Management API - App Versions, HTTP 204). The API returns a bare null when the app version has no schedule, which the tool returns as {"content": "null"}. Inferred from the examples published in the API document; field types reflect the example values.

content.description: "null" when no schedule exists; the other properties are then absent.

failure_reason.description: Only null appears in the published examples.

last_paused_at.description: Only null appears in the published examples.
